2609.08636.title: From Where to How: Continuous 4D Interaction Forecasting from Egocentric Video
2609.08636.paper_summary: Egocentric 4D interaction forecasting aims to anticipate both where future interactions will occur in 3D and how the human body will move to realize them, providing an important capability for assistive robotics and human-computer interaction. Existing methods struggle to translate semantic understanding into precise continuous 3D localization and to balance motion diversity with structural consistency in pose forecasting. More fundamentally, these tasks are often modeled separately, leaving the continuous geometric and temporal correspondence between interaction locations and body motion insufficiently captured. To address these challenges, we introduce Coherent4D, a large-scale egocentric dataset for continuous 4D interaction forecasting, comprising approximately 233K samples across three domains. Each sample pairs a sequence of future 3D interaction locations with corresponding full-body poses, aligned in time and expressed in a shared coordinate system. We also provide evaluation metrics in continuous space. Building on this formulation, we propose HIGFlow, a Hand Interaction Guided Residual Flow framework that models forecasting as a cascaded where-to-how process. HIGFlow first forecasts continuous future interaction locations by combining semantic grounding with short-horizon visual dynamics, and then uses the predicted location sequence to condition a deterministic motion anchor and residual Flow Matching for diverse yet structurally consistent full-body motion forecasting. Extensive experiments across all three domains demonstrate consistent improvements over representative baselines on both location and pose forecasting, while ablations validate the contributions of the proposed components. The project page is available at https://corrineqiu.github.io/from-where-to-how/.
2609.08636.paper_summary_zh: 自我中心的 4D 互動預測旨在預測未來互動將在 3D 中發生的位置以及人體如何移動以實現這些互動，為輔助機器人技術和人機互動提供了重要的能力。現有方法在將語義理解轉化為精確的連續 3D 定位方面存在困難，並且在姿勢預測中難以平衡運動多樣性與結構一致性。更根本的是，這些任務通常是分開建模的，導致互動位置與身體運動之間的連續幾何和時間對應未能充分捕捉。為了解決這些挑戰，我們介紹了 Coherent4D，一個大型自我中心數據集，用於連續 4D 互動預測，包含約 233K 的樣本，涵蓋三個領域。每個樣本將未來 3D 互動位置的序列與對應的全身姿勢配對，這些姿勢在時間上對齊並以共享坐標系表示。我們還提供了在連續空間中的評估指標。在這一框架的基礎上，我們提出了 HIGFlow，一個手部互動引導的殘差流框架，將預測建模為一個連續的從何處到如何的過程。HIGFlow 首先通過將語義基礎與短期視覺動態相結合來預測連續的未來互動位置，然後利用預測的位置序列來條件化確定性運動錨點和殘差流匹配，以實現多樣但結構一致的全身運動預測。在所有三個領域的廣泛實驗中，均顯示出在位置和姿勢預測上對代表性基準的穩定改進，而消融實驗則驗證了所提出組件的貢獻。項目頁面可在 https://corrineqiu.github.io/from-where-to-how/ 獲得。
